actual_type_assessments.name: Trees.minHeight

actual_type_assessments.name: Trees.minHeight_nil

actual_type_assessments.name: Trees.minHeight_le_height

actual_type_assessments.name: Trees.complete_node

actual_type_assessments.name: Trees.complete_map

actual_type_assessments.name: Trees.almostComplete_map
